review_method: Independent source and retained raw-evidence review. No Cargo/build/test/binary execution, child agents, source/triage edits or publication. Sole runtime owner is separate rust-qa-agent.

findings.description: OPEN at exact 8c1aefa. bd-cache-sync directly introduces sc-command and imports its CanonicalLog contract at cron_log.rs:3. Approved ADR-BDC-0016 decision 5 permits only the published sc-cron introducer below isolated Python. No Approved/Active amendment changes that narrow exception. The current private protocol correction leaves this production edge and the strict rejecting graph guard intact.
findings.remediation: Keep ARCH-001 open. The authorized genuine upstream public receiver/type re-export or equivalent canonical-event callback constructor must allow required logging without the direct sync -> sc-command edge; remove that edge and qualify the unchanged isolated-consumer gate. Preserve published 0.1.1, logging and graph policy. No publisher/auth/token work, SDK sidequest, fabricated event, relocated introducer, waiver or exception widening is authorized.

changed_scope_assessment.private_boundary: schedule_protocol.rs is include! inside cfg(test) schedule::tests; helper is shared test infrastructure. No production type family, consumer protocol or feature/dependency added; existing decisions cover the owned-test diagnostics, so no new production structural ADR is required.
changed_scope_assessment.ownership: FixtureChild owns root, captured file and scratch dir. finish delegates to inline no-op observer; optional callback creates no reader task. Both exit/timeout paths call actual kill/wait before final receipt collection. Live observer error/unwind leaves Drop owning cleanup. cleanup_attempted + cleanup_on_drop=false prevent retries/fresh attempts; failed registry evidence retains false cleaned even after actual root wait. Existing SessionFixture explicitly takes default cleanup ownership and is unchanged.
changed_scope_assessment.phase_records: Separate single-writer main/worker JSONL files in owned scratch. Each read is capped at 64KiB+1 and rejects excess, malformed complete lines, wrong root identity/stream or rewritten received records. Live partial tail is deferred; final post-wait partial is an error. Missing worker record is unresolved observation, not proof of non-entry.
changed_scope_assessment.clock_provenance: Owner Instant captured before Command.spawn; spawn-return and outer/setup offsets separately reported. Child body Instant feeds main/worker elapsed values. Parent owner_received timestamps describe collection, not execution. Wall deltas are labeled correlation only and do not drive deadline decisions.
changed_scope_assessment.limits: Original owner-started absolute 5s, 30ms cancellation, 500ms completion observation and 7s supervisor assertion preserved. No fresh timeout is created for protocol collection or a repeated cleanup; the unchanged cleanup observations remain separate ownership cleanup limits.
changed_scope_assessment.normal_and_negative: Original three real operations and assertions remain. Normal path restores session settings/health and joins actual worker. Stalled path still requires original stderr marker and 500ms failure text in qualify; structured return alone cannot pass. Planted busy call records genuine return then parks before marker. Outer control catches the failed qualification, validates DatabaseBusy and root reap; direct flag resumes failure. No parked thread join completion is claimed.

source_equivalence.qualification: Current whole schedule source changed in cfg(test). Shared FixtureChild changed and reviewed freshly. SessionFixture/cron_hurry compared to actual QA9 a753d279, not incorrectly to pre-FTQ011 adbcc88d. No blanket 159 whole-file or full runtime parity claim.

retained_raw_evidence.observed: Read raw postpush 8/8 and default 2/2 result lines, observer error/panic/root-wait control receipts, actual missing-marker FAILED libtest output, and direct driver exit101/5.025715s/no fallback receipt. These are retained developer evidence, not commands independently rerun by arch-qa. Source supports actual kill/wait path; no independent syscall/kernel audit asserted.
